references.text: Jesus uses a similar call to listen carefully in Matthew, which underscores the importance of paying attention to his words.
Jesus speaks about spiritual understanding through listening in the conversation with Nicodemus, reflecting the call to listen in Mark 7:16.

Again in Revelation, the emphasis is on listening to the Holy Spirit's message, parallel to the call in Mark 7:16.
The call to listen carefully is repeated several times in Revelation, showing the importance of being attentive to God's word.
